Honeycomb-like wall of integration logos around a bright centre tile with your product mark, fading out toward the edges. $ pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://www.affectui.com/r/integration-grid.json Preview Code Copy prompt MCP Copy When to use Integration sections and feature cards like “Works with the tools you already use” Landing pages that show your product at the centre of an ecosystem When not to use A real, clickable list of integrations – the tiles are decorative and not links More than 22 logos – the grid has 22 outer tiles, extra logos are left out Installation Add Integration Grid with the shadcn CLI – your project needs a components.json, see Installation in the docs – or copy the file by hand. Requires React 19. Fewer columns make the tiles larger label string – Accessible description – by default lists the integrations className string – Extra class on the root, e.g. for width or margins Accessibility Exposed as one image whose label lists every integration; tiles and logos are hidden from screen readers Nothing in the scene is interactive Motion Still by default; on hover a tile turns fully white and its logo grows a little from the centre With prefers-reduced-motion the hover lift is switched off Responsive behavior Transparent background, so it sits on any light or dark surface Keeps a 1520 : 560 aspect ratio and scales to the width of its container – every size is in container units Tile fills fade toward the edges while the logos keep their full brand colors Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually ) has the class dark or data-theme="dark" affectUI · 54 components · 12 screens · 11 blocks · 24 illustrations · 8 motion effects affectUI Agent-ready React UI for AI products – one file each, no dependencies.
